current_milestone: The continual runtime now accumulates three independently committed hidden acquired-program capabilities across numeric, sequence, and string input domains under distinct exact scopes. Before each new promotion it re-runs all earlier capabilities in fresh Engine instances and uses those observed scores as protected regression measurements. A forced protected regression is rejected and retained as contradictory evidence before each successful promotion. After every stage, fresh Engine instances retain all previous hidden capabilities at score 1, yielding retention matrix sizes 1, 2, and 3 with no forgetting. Hidden seeds and answers are not persisted. This remains an internally generated bounded campaign, not independent AGI evidence.

claim_boundary: No architecture, hourly model choice, CI/reference result, bounded learning campaign, trial-ledger result, internal regression decision, self-produced artifact, or unsigned/unverified independence assertion counts as verified AGI. A verified claim requires the conservative external production evidence gate to pass on genuinely independent auditable evidence with no unresolved failures or contamination.
